findings.minimal_fix: Emit one parseable terminal JSON receipt with status/stage/code and bounded fields; remove key=value lines.
findings.reason: All success and stop paths emit key=value lines via KV2/KVL/printf instead of a single parseable terminal JSON receipt. Evidenced by source macros and receipt_format requirement; consequence is unparsable automated status adjudication.

findings.minimal_fix: Map NOT_CHECKED to exit code 2, FAIL1/REFUSED to exit code 1, and PAYLOAD_EXPERIMENT_ONLY to 0 per specification; keep status enum strictly distinct from exit codes.
findings.reason: The stop handler unconditionally invokes exit(1) even for NOT_CHECKED states, conflating missing environment prerequisites (e.g. absent hardware, unsupported driver attributes) with attempted execution failures. Spec requires NOT_CHECKED exit 2.

findings.minimal_fix: Check every destroy/free/close return value, propagate first error, and set cleanup_unknown=true on any failure or unquiesced timeout path.
findings.reason: cleanup ignores all destruction, deallocation, and close return values, yet all termination receipts declare cleanup_unknown=false. There is no verified quiescence after fence timeout; claimed certainty is unevidenced.

findings.minimal_fix: Call pinned CUDA 13.4 four-argument cuCtxCreate_v4(context, params, flags, device) exactly; do not pass legacy 3 arguments.
findings.reason: Measured COMPILE_FAILED under GCC 13.3 with CUDA 13.4: cuCtxCreate takes 4 arguments (cuCtxCreate_v4(&cctx, nullptr, 0, cdev)). Calling with 3 arguments fails compilation with too few arguments.

findings.minimal_fix: Read pinned ze_api.h memoryAllocationImportTypes for DMA-BUF support.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: ze_device_external_memory_properties_t has no member memoryImportSupported in pinned ze_api.h:2738-2748. The capability gate cannot compile or evaluate as written.

findings.minimal_fix: Set ifd.flags=ZE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_TYPE_FLAG_DMA_BUF with correct stype/pNext/flags/fd per pinned descriptor.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: ze_external_memory_import_fd_t has no member type per pinned ze_api.h:8080-8088; actual members are stype, pNext, flags, and fd. Import descriptor cannot compile.

findings.minimal_fix: Test ZE_COMMAND_QUEUE_GROUP_PROPERTY_FLAG_COPY and PROPERTY_FLAG_COMPUTE per pinned ze_api.h:2378-2381.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: ZE_COMMAND_QUEUE_GROUP_COPY_BIT and ZE_COMMAND_QUEUE_GROUP_COMPUTE_BIT are undeclared identifiers; pinned names are PROPERTY_FLAG variants. Queue selection cannot compile.

findings.minimal_fix: Call 5-argument zeMemAllocHost(context, desc, size, alignment, pptr) with explicit alignment.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: too few arguments and void** to size_t conversion vs pinned ze_api.h:7619-7627 requiring explicit alignment argument.

findings.minimal_fix: Call zeCommandListCreate(context, device, desc, pHandle) with zctx as arg1.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: cannot convert ze_device_handle_t to ze_context_handle_t vs pinned ze_api.h:3983-3988. Context handle argument was omitted.

findings.minimal_fix: Call zeCommandQueueCreate(context, device, desc, pHandle) with zctx as arg1.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: device handle passed in place of context handle vs pinned ze_api.h:3588-3593 requiring context first. Context handle argument was omitted.

findings.minimal_fix: Call 5-argument zeEventPoolCreate(context, desc, numDevices, phDevices, pPool) with explicit device array or nullptr.
findings.reason: Measured compilation failure: cannot convert ze_event_pool_handle_t* to ze_device_handle_t* vs pinned ze_api.h:5507-5517. Device-count and device-array arguments are mishandled.

findings.minimal_fix: Explicitly verify FD lifetime against target Level Zero driver contract; close application duplicate on error and mark ownership transfer unambiguously without assuming universal consumption across all runtimes.
findings.reason: Critique of Muse vs ROOT: Muse asserted the code assumed FD consumption on success without primary proof. ROOT confirms that in Intel runtime commit d4fc0756, zeMemAllocDevice with DEVICE FD import does consume the descriptor on success and retains it on failure, so setting import_fd=-1 on success matches that runtime branch. However, because generic Level Zero specifications do not document universal FD consumption across all vendors and drivers, and installed-driver behavior is untested, unverified transfer ownership remains a portability and leak/double-close concern.

findings.minimal_fix: Validate CUDA UUID, Intel root UUID, CUDA DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED, and L0 import caps before cuMemAlloc/export; emit NOT_CHECKED on absent prerequisites without side effects.
findings.reason: Critique of Muse vs ROOT: Muse inaccurately asserted that CUDA allocation precedes the DMA_BUF gate. In fact, cuMemAlloc (line 45) occurs AFTER cuDeviceGetAttribute(&dma, CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED, cdev) (line 42). However, Muse is correct that CUDA context creation precedes the DMA_BUF gate, and both CUDA context creation and allocation precede Intel device enumeration, Intel UUID matching, and Level Zero DMA-BUF capability checks, creating side effects prior to establishing Intel prerequisite eligibility.

findings.minimal_fix: Bound device enumeration, surface query errors as NOT_CHECKED, validate root/device type, and check zeMemGetAllocProperties owner matches intended Intel root.
findings.reason: Enumeration is unbounded with silent skip (continue) on query errors instead of surfacing NOT_CHECKED; PCI domain/bus/device queries ignore return values; root GPU type and imported allocation owner handle (apdev) are never validated against the intended physical device.

findings.minimal_fix: On fence/event timeout report cleanup_unknown=true and avoid destroying potentially busy list/queue/allocations without verified quiescence.
findings.reason: A 10s fence timeout routes through cleanup() which destroys command lists, queues, events, and frees device memory without verifying hardware quiescence, risking undefined behavior or host/GPU crashes while claiming cleanup_unknown=false.
